description: Angular component for entity autocomplete functionality in the Thingsboard platform, managing entity selection, display, and fetching logic.

classes.name: EntityAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for entity selection with autocomplete, supporting various entity types and dynamic loading.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form control.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events; no implementation provided.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting up entity filtering and loading entity type labels.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Sets display labels and messages based on the current entity type.

methods.name: getCurrentEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected entity from the form group.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the component's form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a value to the component, fetching entity data if necessary.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updating validation state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the entity selection in the form group.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and emits change events when the selected entity changes.

methods.name: displayEntityFn
methods.description: Returns display string for an entity, optionally using display name.

methods.name: fetchEntities
methods.description: Fetches entities matching the search text, excluding specified IDs.

methods.name: textIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is non-empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the current selection and refocuses input.

methods.name: checkEntityType
methods.description: Converts alias entity types to concrete entity types based on user authority.

methods.name: createNewEntity
methods.description: Emits event to create a new entity with optional search text.

methods.name: showEntityLink
methods.description: Determines if the entity link should be shown.

methods.name: markAsTouched
methods.description: Marks the form control as touched.
